profile.headline: Staff Software Engineer at SiriusXM + Pandora
profile.summary:
My mission as an effective developer, capable of making immediate positive contributions in a collaborative setting, is finding and working with teams that are equally passionate about creating quality, impactful products. 

- I have solid knowledge of JavaScript, HTML5, CSS3 and work well with Bootstrap, Sass, and  Semantic UI
- Solid understanding of Object-oriented Programming, Data Structures, and Algorithms
- Practical Experience with React-Redux application development
- Well familiar with MEAN (MongoDB, Express, React, Node) stack
- Well familiar with front-end MV* frameworks, such as Angular
- Practical Experience with backend frameworks, like Node.js/Express.js.
- Experience with MongoDB (Mongoose), MySQL, knowing the languages
- Well familiar with Cloud Infrastructure/Orchestration and practical experience with AWS, Heroku, and Docker.
- Good knowledge of the software development lifecycle (SDLC) and Agile development practice
- Experience in Android application development using Eclipse IDE (ADT Plugin), Android Studio
- Working knowledge with XML, SOAP, JSON and Restful technologies

positions.title: Front End Developer
positions.description:
- Responsible for Development of dynamic Web applications using top-notch web Technologies and JavaScript frameworks.
- Creating a custom, single-page, responsive web applications to replace a legacy line-of-business web application using Node.js, React.js, HTML5, CSS3, Bootstrap 4 and JSON.
- Implemented analytics dashboard by creating Splunk search queries and integrate Splunk results to web application framework using Splunk API. Used Splunk Charts for dynamic, interactive data visualizations on web browsers. 
- Worked on cross-browser responsiveness and compatibility. Developed unit test cases with Jest, Enzyme and used webpack as the UI build mechanism.
- Extensively worked on REST Services and dependency injection.
- Integrated with multiple API services by making Restful web service calls using Node.js. 
- Writing controllers that are responsible for transferring control between components, making AJAX calls, routing and rendering views. 
- Supercharged the performance of queries related to user data by implementing caching backed by Redis and dynamically handled applications data by making queries to MySQL database.
- Collaborate closely with technical and product teams to transform a concept into code along with other software developers and help troubleshooting in web-based application issues.  Co-ordinate with QA for testing, Production releases, Application deployment, and integration. Involved in the development, test, deploy and maintenance of the website application. collaborate in website development phases include but are not limited to website design, website development, unit test, integration, and deployment of development servers.
- Using Jenkins for basically deployment of the web applications to Development, QA and Production servers.
- Following the Software development life cycle SDLC and working in an AGILE based development environment and participating in Scrum sessions.

company.name: Big Mirror Labs | Sirius XM Radio Inc.

positions.title: Full Stack Web Developer
positions.description:
- Developed and maintaining an e-commerce website based on Magento platform, and CMS applications based on WordPress platform.
- Custom, private Magento apps built with PHP, Node.js, Firebase, MongoDB, AWS, and Heroku. 
- Frontend implementation in HTML, CSS, Ajax, Javascript, jQuery, and Bootstrap. 
- Optimizing Page loading speed, resolving cross-browser compatibility to improve UX.
- I am responsible for Finding and fixing vulnerabilities. Applying security patches. Marketing with social networking and paid-advertising. Regularly contribute to growth, UX design, and overall business strategies
- Brainstorming and engineering multivariate A/B tests with Optimizely, interpreting results and mapping action plan based on said results.

positions.title: Android Application Developer Intern
positions.description:
- Participated in sprint planning meeting to decide the project component backlog and reported updates during the daily SCRUM meetings. 
- Parsed the data that were coming as JSON format using Android’s built-in JSON Object library. 
- Design local database and tables in the app to store the data locally using SQLite.
- Utilized web services (HTTP based, XML, SOAP, JSON or other services), in order to tie applications to critical server-side APIs.
- Developed an android app with Java, Android SDK, PHP and RESTful APIs consuming. Designed and implemented UI interface to interact with the users to take the order information.

projects.title: HooKed – React w/ Firebase App
projects.description:
• Created a real-time app for a fictitious seafood market where price and quantity can change at moment’s notice by authorized users.
• Constructed front end with React, Stylus, JavaScript, HTML and CSS. Leveraged Firebase to store database and improved social authentication strategy with OAuth.

projects.title: COLORIFY -Mini Game
projects.description:
Developed an addictive, fast-paced, color picker mini game which drives people crazy over color and time
Technologies: jQuery, JavaScript, HTML5, CSS3
